title: Active Inference as Context Acquisition for AI Agents
description:
arXiv:2608.19202v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Interactive AI agents must acquire the right context as efficiently as possible. When a user omits a constraint, preference, file, or task variable, an agent can proceed with a default assumption or spend tokens on a clarifying question, retrieval call, tool call, or prompt trial.
